|translation='''Title:''' R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo).

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to power and hyperspeed of a capital starship it is aboard. That capital starship also gains immunity to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:'''
Programmed to calculate sublight tactical courses. R5 units are widely used on combat starships. R5-M2 helped plan Echo Base evacuation routes. Owned by Shawn Valdez.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed parenthetical is アーファイブ・エムトゥ, not Emmtoo.
